challenge.method: Checked whether the README heading and bounded notice establish the attribution and date, whether the Index decision refers to the same entity and captured bytes, and whether the lifecycle could instead refer to the macro file or an SPDX status.
challenge.results: The README names Hunter Goatley, is dated January 22, 2004, and attributes the 1989–2004 copyright to him. The Index decision assigns historical documentary status to the matching entity, edition, and full README digest. It records the 56,558-byte macro file as a separate source revision. SPDX records Newsletr as nondeprecated in its own classification.

limitations: The finding is scoped to the captured README and the Index decision. The macro implementation and package catalog are outside the acquired evidence, as are other editions, installation, text reuse, and legal effect.

The pinned adoption manifest and CI caller were verified. The declared policy bundle digest was read from the manifest, and the entire bundle was outside the acquired evidence. This is an independent claim review, with publication qualification outside its scope.
